solutions.title: Core Solutions
solutions.eap_description: Using the SECS/GEM protocol to realize equipment networking, automated recipe management, equipment monitoring, and data collection, forming the foundational architecture of a smart factory.
solutions.rcm_description: Centralized management of factory equipment, providing multi‑screen monitoring, remote operation, operation recording, and complete audit tracing.
solutions.rpa_description: Combining AI‑powered vision recognition to automatically execute repetitive tasks, increase the man‑to‑machine ratio, and reduce human errors.
solutions.spc_description: Real‑time monitoring of process capability with automated alerts and preventive quality management.
solutions.aidc_description: Applying AI‑based deep learning for defect classification and vision inspection to boost inspection throughput and improve yield rates.
solutions.aiot_description: Comprehensive visualization and control, effective downtime prevention, and real‑time monitoring.

aboutUs.title: ABOUT AIE
aboutUs.company_introduction_description: Founded in 2018, the company specializes in smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 solutions, serving industries such as semiconductors, display panels, PCBs, and electronics manufacturing, and providing enterprises with comprehensive intelligent manufacturing solutions.
aboutUs.all_in_description:
We provide remote control systems (RCM), manufacturing process automation (RPA), AIoT, Big Data analytics platforms, and self‑developed AI software to meet the needs of smart manufacturing. 
 With a comprehensive workflow of real‑time inspection, analysis, prediction, and response, we help enterprises resolve issues that arise during manufacturing.
aboutUs.AI_decision_description: By integrating artificial intelligence technologies, we enable real‑time inspection, analysis, prediction, and anomaly handling, helping enterprises continuously optimize their processes and fully realize the value of Industry 4.0 and smart factories.
